youtube.title: The Jellyfish That Can Live Forever 🪼 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
There's a jellyfish that can turn back time.

It's smaller than your fingernail, and it lives in the sea. When it's hurt, starving or old, it doesn't die. It melts back into a blob and grows into a baby again. Then it starts its whole life over. Again and again. It can still be eaten. But old age? It simply skips it.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.

#Shorts #nature #ocean #science #thehiddenwhy
